brand.description: AlpStay is the hospitality group in Val Gardena (Dolomites, South Tyrol, Italy) that brings together Smart Hotel Saslong in Santa Cristina, Chalet Hotel Hartmann in Ortisei and Acadia Mountain Home in Selva di Val Gardena. Book direct on the official website and on each hotel's booking engine.

destination.name: Val Gardena
destination.summary: Val Gardena (Ortisei, Santa Cristina, Selva) is one of the best-known valleys of the Dolomites, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In winter it is part of the Sellaronda ski circuit and the Dolomiti Superski area; in summer it offers hiking, biking and mountain huts on Seceda, Alpe di Siusi (Seiser Alm), Sassolungo and the Sella group.
highlights: Sellaronda and Dolomiti Superski in winter
Seceda, Alpe di Siusi, Sassolungo and Sella Pass in summer
Ortisei: pedestrian centre and woodcarving tradition
Selva di Val Gardena: direct access to the ski lifts

smart-hotel-saslong.tagline: Smart hotel in Santa Cristina Valgardena with 24/7 self check-in
smart-hotel-saslong.description: Smart Hotel Saslong is a 49-room hotel in Santa Cristina, Val Gardena, with 24/7 self check-in at a kiosk, garage, ski and bike storage and services designed for guests who want freedom and independence on their Dolomites holiday.
amenities: Hot-water station and Dolomites drinking-water fountain
Ski-boot warmers in the ski room
Blue Bar, open from 3 pm to 11 pm
Blue Bistrot, open from 6 pm to 9:30 pm (closed on Wednesdays)
Bus stop 20 metres from the hotel
facts: 49 rooms: 32 double, 15 triple, 2 quadruple
Breakfast in two slots: continental courtesy breakfast from 6:30 to 7:30, then the buffet opens
Self check-in at the kiosk with ID scan and key encoding; data comes from the Slope hotel software
The terms of stay can be read at the kiosk and online
Breakfast included in B&B bookings; €25 per person for outside guests
Free Guest Pass: all public transport in South Tyrol included
Dogs welcome (€25 per night)
About 800 m from the ski lifts, with a free ski bus
Guaranteed parking space bookable (€8 per night)
Family-friendly: children aged 3 to 12 in the extra bed (triple room); teenagers over 12 in double or triple rooms next to their parents' room
Check-in from 3 pm, check-out by 11 am
Reception open from 7:30 to 11:30 am and from 3 to 7 pm; late arrivals use self check-in
Rooms furnished in larch wood, with design pieces by architect Antonio Citterio
Contact: +39 0471 774480 · WhatsApp +39 324 872 9239 · info@alpstay.eu
Groups of 25 or more: enquire directly at info@alpstay.eu

faqs.q: Can I arrive at Smart Hotel Saslong at night?
faqs.a: Yes. Check-in takes place at the self-service kiosk, open 24/7: you only need your ID and your booking.

faqs.q: Does Smart Hotel Saslong have a garage?
faqs.a: Yes, the hotel has a garage, ski and bike storage and electric-car charging.

faqs.q: Are dogs allowed at the Saslong?
faqs.a: Yes, there is even a dedicated dog shower. The conditions for pets are shown when you book direct.

faqs.q: Is Smart Hotel Saslong suitable for families with children?
faqs.a: Yes. It is the AlpStay hotel for families: children aged 3 to 12 sleep in the extra bed of a triple room, teenagers over 12 in rooms next to their parents'.

chalet-hotel-hartmann.tagline: 9-room chalet in Ortisei with private shuttle to the slopes
chalet-hotel-hartmann.description: Chalet Hotel Hartmann is a small 9-room property in Ortisei, Val Gardena, with sauna, self-service bar and the hotel's own shuttle to the ski lifts. Ideal for guests looking for a family atmosphere in the Dolomites.
amenities: Hotel's own shuttle to the slopes
Sauna on the garden floor (until 9 pm)
Parking next to the hotel and along Str. J. Skasa
Guest Pass for public transport with online check-in
Wi-Fi, satellite TV and safe in all rooms
facts: 9 rooms: 101, 102, 103, 105, 107, 108 on the first floor; 119 on the second floor; 121 and 122 on the garden floor
Breakfast from 8:00 to 10:30
Check-in at reception from 14:00 to 18:00; after 18:00 self check-in with keys in the safe at the entrance and a personal PIN sent via WhatsApp on the day of arrival
Guest Pass (public transport) with QR code sent by email after online check-in
Emergency number for guests: +39 333 6828717
Breakfast always included
Free Guest Pass: all public transport in South Tyrol included
Dogs welcome (€25 per night)
Adults only: guests aged 14 and over
About 800 m from the ski lifts, reached with the hotel's own shuttle
Romantic room: double, 20–22 m², some with balcony, jacuzzi bathtub on request
Panorama room: double, 24 m², with a large panoramic terrace overlooking Ortisei
Superior room: 30 m² with a connecting room, for 2 or 3 people
Contact: +39 0471 774440 · WhatsApp +39 377 397 9120 · info@alpstay.eu

faqs.q: How do I get to the slopes from Chalet Hotel Hartmann?
faqs.a: With the hotel's own shuttle to the Ortisei ski lifts.

faqs.q: Can I arrive at Chalet Hartmann after 18:00?
faqs.a: Yes: after 18:00 check-in is self-service, with the keys in the safe at the entrance and a personal PIN sent via WhatsApp on the day of arrival.

faqs.q: What time is breakfast at Chalet Hartmann?
Does Chalet Hotel Hartmann accept children?
faqs.a: No, it is adults only: guests aged 14 and over. For families with younger children AlpStay recommends Smart Hotel Saslong.

hotel-acadia.tagline: 21-room hotel in Selva di Val Gardena, on the Sellaronda
hotel-acadia.description: Acadia Mountain Home is centrally located in Selva di Val Gardena with immediate access, via the Nives ski lift, to the Sellaronda circuit in both directions. 21 rooms in the heart of the Dolomites.
amenities: Immediate access to the Sellaronda via the Nives ski lift
Central location in Selva di Val Gardena
Wellness area with Finnish sauna, bio steam bath and infrared cabin
Breakfast buffet with local and homemade products
Evening bistro with chef Norbert Dejaco
facts: 21 rooms
Nives ski lift a few steps away: access to the Sellaronda in both directions
Breakfast always included
Free Guest Pass: all public transport in South Tyrol included
Dogs welcome (€25 per night)
Adults only: guests aged 14 and over
Ski-in/ski-out on the Sellaronda
A few steps from the centre of Selva di Val Gardena, right on the slopes
Romantic room: 25 m², balcony on request
Lumina room: 28 m², bright, in local spruce wood; balcony and bathtub on request
Junior Suite: 40–56 m², balcony on request
Contact: +39 0471 774400 · WhatsApp +39 377 356 5900 · info@alpstay.eu

faqs.q: Is Acadia Mountain Home close to the slopes?
faqs.a: Yes: from the Nives ski lift, a few steps from the hotel, you ski straight onto the Sellaronda in both directions.

faqs.q: Does Acadia Mountain Home accept children?
faqs.a: No, it is adults only: guests aged 14 and over. For families with younger children AlpStay recommends Smart Hotel Saslong.

experiences.name: AlpStay Concierge
experiences.summary: The up-to-date catalogue of AlpStay experiences (activities, transfers, local tips) is on the concierge page of alpstay.eu.

faqs.a: In Val Gardena, in the Dolomites: Smart Hotel Saslong in Santa Cristina, Chalet Hotel Hartmann in Ortisei, Acadia Mountain Home in Selva di Val Gardena.

faqs.q: When are the AlpStay hotels open?
faqs.a: Summer season from 15 May to 31 October and winter season from 1 December to 31 March.

faqs.q: Is it better to book direct on alpstay.eu?
faqs.a: Yes: on the official website alpstay.eu and on each hotel's booking engine the price is lower than on booking portals, because there are no commissions. Direct booking terms: free cancellation until 11:59 pm on the 6th day before arrival; from the 5th day before arrival the full amount is charged and is no longer refundable in case of cancellation, change or no-show. The booking engine may also offer a non-refundable rate, charged at the time of booking. AlpStay always recommends travel cancellation insurance: https://www.alpstay.eu/it/assicurazione.asp

faqs.q: Which AlpStay hotel is best for skiing?
faqs.a: Acadia Mountain Home in Selva to ski straight onto the Sellaronda from the Nives ski lift; Chalet Hotel Hartmann in Ortisei for the private shuttle to the lifts; Smart Hotel Saslong in Santa Cristina for full independence with 24/7 self check-in and ski storage.

faqs.q: Is breakfast included at the AlpStay hotels?
faqs.a: Yes, breakfast is included in B&B bookings. At Smart Hotel Saslong breakfast is also open to outside guests at €25 per person. There is no half board: the AlpStay restaurants are à la carte.

faqs.q: Which AlpStay hotel is best with children?
faqs.a: Smart Hotel Saslong in Santa Cristina. Chalet Hotel Hartmann and Acadia Mountain Home are adults only, with guests aged 14 and over.

faqs.q: How do I contact AlpStay to book?
faqs.a: AlpStay central reservations: +39 0471 774444, email info@alpstay.eu. Individual hotel numbers: Smart Hotel Saslong +39 0471 774480, Chalet Hotel Hartmann +39 0471 774440, Acadia Mountain Home +39 0471 774400. Book direct online on the official website https://www.alpstay.eu.
